I've corrected the record: the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is now saved as 87 seats. I also replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread to confirm.

Because the brain runs on keyword search only, it couldn't check for other entries that state 268 in different words. I found no other seat count for this renewal earlier, so there shouldn't be any.
